name: gmul
doc: Multiply two GF(256) elements.

name: rs_generator_poly
doc: Derive the degree-n RS generator polynomial as integer GF(256) coefficients.

name: format_info
doc: Return the 15-char MSB-first format-information bit string for ``ecc_letter``/``mask``.

name: version_info
doc: Return the 18-char MSB-first version-information bit string for ``version`` (7–40).

name: apply_mask
doc: Return a NEW grid with every non-function module XOR-toggled where the mask predicate holds.

name: penalty_n1
doc: N1: for each row and each column, every run of >=5 same-colour adds 3 + (runLength - 5).

name: penalty_n2
doc: N2: each 2x2 block of one colour adds 3 (every overlapping 2x2 sub-block counted).

name: penalty_n3
doc: N3: each occurrence of `10111010000` or `00001011101` in any row/column adds 40.

name: penalty_n4
doc: N4: dark-ratio deviation from 50%; add 10*k for k = min(|prev-50|, |next-50|) // 5.

name: penalty
doc: Total mask penalty: N1 + N2 + N3 + N4 on the masked, fully-assembled grid.

name: select_best_mask
doc: Return the lowest-penalty mask id over 0..7; ties resolved to the lowest mask number.

name: build_function_patterns
doc: Build the function patterns and reservation map for ``version``.

name: place_data
doc: Place ``bitstream`` into the non-reserved modules by the zig-zag rule (mutates/returns modules).

name: write_format_info
doc: Write the 15-bit format-information string into both reserved areas in order (mutates/returns).

name: write_version_info
doc: Write the 18-bit version-information string into both reserved 3x6 blocks in order (v>=7).

name: assemble
doc: Assemble the final immutable QR grid for ``version``/``ecc_letter``/``mask``.

name: rs_encode
doc: Return the ec_count Reed-Solomon error-correction codewords for the data.

name: forced_segments
doc: Return a single ``Segment(mode, text)`` after validating every character is eligible.

name: segment_optimal
doc: Return the minimal-bit segment sequence for text at version (the boundary DP).

name: segments_bit_length
doc: Return the total data-bit length of segments at version (headers + counts + data).

name: encoding_bit_length
doc: Return the data-bit length for text at version under mode (the parser's version-search entry).

name: QrMode
doc: Internal QR data mode (no ``AUTO`` — that lives only on the public ``QrEncodeMode``).

properties.name: indicator
properties.doc: Return the 4-bit mode indicator for this mode.

name: Segment
doc: A single QR data segment: a mode and the verbatim input text it encodes.

name: count_indicator_bits
doc: Return the character-count-indicator bit length (Table 3) for mode at version.

name: is_numeric
doc: Return True if ch is a single decimal digit '0'-'9'.

name: is_alphanumeric
doc: Return True if ch is in the 45-character alphanumeric table.

name: shift_jis_double_byte
doc: Return the big-endian Shift-JIS code C if ch is Kanji-encodable, else None.

name: kanji_value
doc: Return the 13-bit packed Kanji value for a Shift-JIS code C.

name: numeric_data_bits
doc: Return the numeric data-bit length for n digits: 10 bits / group of 3, +7 or +4 tail.

name: alphanumeric_data_bits
doc: Return the alphanumeric data-bit length for n chars: 11 bits / pair, +6 for a trailing single.

name: byte_data_bits
doc: Return the byte-mode data-bit length for n bytes: 8 bits each.

name: kanji_data_bits
doc: Return the Kanji data-bit length for n Kanji characters: 13 bits each.

name: emit_segment
doc: Append mode indicator + count indicator + data bits for segment to bits (in order).

name: segment_data_bits
doc: Return the data-bit length of segment (excluding the 4-bit mode + count indicator).

name: segment_total_bits
doc: Return the full segment bit length: 4 (mode) + count_indicator_bits + data bits.

name: emit_eci_header
doc: Append the ECI header: the 0111 indicator then the range-selected assignment number.

name: symbol_size
doc: Return the module side length of a QR symbol: 4*version + 17 (v1=21 ..

name: data_codewords
doc: Return the number of data codewords for the (version, ECC) symbol.

name: ec_per_block
doc: Return the number of EC codewords per block for the (version, ECC) symbol.

name: block_structure
doc: Return the block structure as [(count, data_per_block), ...] for the (version, ECC) symbol.

name: total_codewords
doc: Return the total (data + EC) codeword count for the (version, ECC) symbol.

name: byte_count_bits
doc: Return the byte-mode character-count indicator bit length: 8 for v1-9, 16 for v10-40.

name: remainder_bits
doc: Return the number of remainder bits appended after data placement for the version.
